title: Nameless Chart
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Nameless Chart and the helm marks False Mark. Do: Close on False Mark. The chart lies. False Rain moves. The jackpot body may be empty. Finish on the false mark anyway so the lie is on the slate. Finish: come inside False Mark's shell. A drift rumor. The map is still wrong. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
